tasks.title: First irrigation after sowing
tasks.note: In Punjab Agricultural University trials, 75 mm for the first irrigation gave clearly better yield than 65 mm, and 85 mm added little more. Confirm the quantity for your field with the local KVK.

tasks.title: Nitrogen top-dressing before the first irrigation
tasks.note: Apply the top-dressing share of nitrogen just before the irrigation, not after it. In a Punjab trial, half the nitrogen at sowing and half at the first irrigation gave yield on par with a three-way split and better than the other timings tested. Total dose and fertilizer form should follow your Soil Health Card or the local KVK.

sources.title: Indian Journal of Agronomy: sowing time and split nitrogen in bread wheat (Amritsar, Punjab)
Journal of Wheat Research: nitrogen top dressing just before irrigation improves wheat growth

tasks.title: Weed check and control window
tasks.note: The critical period for weed control is put at about 15 to 30 days after sowing. Where no herbicide is used, hand weeding at about 20 and 35 days is advised. In Punjab trials, post-emergence herbicides were applied around 30 days after sowing. Product choice and dose must come from your KVK, and the label must be followed.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University agritech portal: weed management in wheat
